name: doppler
description: Doppler-backed environment management — env vars from Doppler branched configs + plain docker-compose, with per-worktree auto-provisioning. Replaces composable.env as the default InDusk env layer.

hooks.on_enable: echo 'Doppler extension enabled. Add your Doppler service token to .indusk/extensions/doppler/.env (copy from .env.example), then env auto-provisions on worktree create.'
hooks.on_disable: echo 'Doppler extension disabled. .indusk/extensions/doppler/.env is left in place; remove it manually if you no longer want the token on disk.'
